# How Do I Integrate Pricing Tools With Financial Workflows?


You integrate pricing tools by having the dynamically set price feed directly into the correct financial record, without manual re-entry between the pricing tool and finance. On **Jestor** , this uses webhooks or open API to connect external pricing data to the financial structure.


Operators using dedicated dynamic pricing tools often end up with a gap between the price set and what actually gets recorded in finance.


## What disconnected pricing and finance costs


- The price set by the pricing tool not automatically reflected in the financial record
- Manual re-entry of the final reservation value into the financial system
- Discrepancies between the price shown to the guest and what is recorded internally
- No unified visibility between pricing strategy and actual financial outcome


## How the integration works


- **Webhooks** from the pricing tool can feed directly into the reservation record
- The final value connects to the financial record without manual re-entry
- Native integration with **Omie** or **Conta Azul** keeps everything synced from there
- Dashboards can compare set price versus actual revenue by property


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Webhooks and open API allow connection to most modern pricing tools
- Once connected, data flows automatically through to the ERP entry
- Reduces discrepancies between what is charged and what is recorded
- Gives unified visibility between pricing strategy and financial outcome

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does this work with any dynamic pricing tool?** It depends on the tool having webhooks or API available for connection. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does this require a developer to set up?** It depends on the complexity of the specific integration.


**Does the final price reflect automatically in the ERP?** Yes, once the data flow is connected end to end.
